transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot manage what we cannot measure — understanding true prevalence, IFR, and spread is the foundation of every decision that follows.

actions.rationale: We cannot manage what we cannot measure — understanding true prevalence, IFR, and spread is the foundation of every decision that follows.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Slowing importation of new cases buys critical weeks for domestic preparation while the pathogen's characteristics are still unknown.

actions.rationale: Slowing importation of new cases buys critical weeks for domestic preparation while the pathogen's characteristics are still unknown.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: PPE, test kits, and ventilator production lead times are weeks long — invoking the DPA now prevents supply shortfalls that would otherwise arrive at the worst moment.

actions.rationale: PPE, test kits, and ventilator production lead times are weeks long — invoking the DPA now prevents supply shortfalls that would otherwise arrive at the worst moment.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Public trust is a finite resource; honest daily communication now prevents the panic and non-compliance that follows a loss of credibility later.

actions.rationale: Public trust is a finite resource; honest daily communication now prevents the panic and non-compliance that follows a loss of credibility later.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Every week of delay in starting a crash vaccine and therapeutics program translates directly into lives lost if this virus proves severe and widespread.

actions.rationale: Every week of delay in starting a crash vaccine and therapeutics program translates directly into lives lost if this virus proves severe and widespread.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Emergency funding authority and legal backing for extraordinary measures must be secured before the crisis escalates, not after.

actions.rationale: Emergency funding authority and legal backing for extraordinary measures must be secured before the crisis escalates, not after.

SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.8 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 3/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 19/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: With infection index accelerating to 1.8, masking is the highest-leverage, lowest-cost intervention to reduce transmission before we have full severity data.

actions.rationale: With infection index accelerating to 1.8, masking is the highest-leverage, lowest-cost intervention to reduce transmission before we have full severity data.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Regardless of whether this proves mild or catastrophic, shielding the elderly and high-risk now prevents the worst-case deaths while keeping broader society functioning.

actions.rationale: Regardless of whether this proves mild or catastrophic, shielding the elderly and high-risk now prevents the worst-case deaths while keeping broader society functioning.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: Transparent real-time data empowers the public to understand the threat, justifies policy actions, and builds the trust needed for compliance with harder measures ahead.

actions.rationale: Transparent real-time data empowers the public to understand the threat, justifies policy actions, and builds the trust needed for compliance with harder measures ahead.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Getting emergency household and small-business relief in place now, while the economy is still at 99, creates the financial backstop that allows health measures to be sustained without catastrophic hardship.
